question.text: Among \(\mathrm{SO}_2, \mathrm{NF}_3, \mathrm{NH}_3, \mathrm{XeF}_2, \mathrm{ClF}_3\) and \(\mathrm{SF}_4\), the hybridization of the molecule with non-zero dipole moment and highest number of lone-pairs of electrons on the central atom is

solution.text:
\(\begin{array}{|c|c|c|c|}
\hline \text { Molecule } & \text { Hybridisation } & \begin{array}{c}
\text { Dipole } \\
\text { Moment }
\end{array} & \begin{array}{c}
\text { Lone pair on the } \\
\text { central atom }

\hline \mathrm{NF}_3 & \mathrm{sp}^3 & \text { Non-zero } & \mathrm{1} \\
